label: Photomultiplier tube 1 gain setting
definition_quote: PMT1_GAIN PMT1 Gain 4.63 to 10 V For recommended device control voltage of 0.5 to 1.1 V. Gain range is 5x103 to 3.5x106. Gain=2x106 * (Output voltage/9.2645)^8.643856. Or Output voltage = 10^(0.115689 * log(Gain) + 0.23786213). Device is Hamamatsu H10722-10-MOD2.

label: Photomultiplier tube 3 gain setting
definition_quote: PMT3_GAIN PMT3 Gain 4.63 to 10 For recommended device control voltage of 0.5 to 1.1 V. Gain range is 5x103 to 3.5x106. Gain=2x106 * (Output voltage/9.2645)^8.643856. Or Output voltage = 10^(0.115689 * log(Gain) + 0.23786213). Device is Hamamatsu H10722-10-MOD2.

label: Photomultiplier tube current, OH* (310 nm band)
definition_quote: [S2, p. 5] 0 to 4 µA. Current (µA) = Voltage * 1. Depends on PMT1_GAIN, Table 3. Device is Hamamatsu H10722-10- MOD2. Looks through a 310 nm bandpass interference filter [S3, p. 11] but one will have a 310-nm bandpass filter and another will have a 430-nm bandpass filter (where both are with a 10-nm FWHM). The pair of detectors will enable measurement of OH* and CH* emission, respectively.
